scope_guard: Synthetic mechanism benchmark only; not a universal database benchmark and not Frank target-runtime acceptance.

derived_query_comparisons.interpretation: Prepared possibility semantics preserves the exact semantic-closure top-k while reducing hot-read latency; direct row retrieval is faster but fails the compositional possibility task.

compile_and_memory.guard: Python object-size estimate and SQLite page bytes are not equivalent allocator/RSS measures; treat only as rough local footprint signals.

web_fusion.use: Strong direct text-retrieval baseline; FTS ranking retrieves matching rows but does not itself define latent possibility semantics.
Motivated compiling/materializing higher-order deltas so updates maintain prepared views rather than rebuilding query state.
Supports bit-parallel set/intersection direction for prepared semantic closures and rule prerequisite masks.
Supports sparse frontier/matrix-vector formulation for future larger ClayGraph projections rather than all-pairs graph traversal.

hypothesis: A compiled possibility-preprocessor that shifts semantic closure/composition work to delta time can make Frank hot cognition depend on the prepared relevant neighborhood rather than total memory/search cost.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The observed gain is only Python-int bitset specialization on a synthetic bounded-horizon workload; a tuned database/index/query compiler can match or beat it once equivalent semantics, updates, larger horizons, deletions, conflicts and real Frank distributions are included.
next_falsifiers: Replay real UnifiedDB/ClayGraph records and real Frank retrieval failures instead of synthetic tokens.
Compare against SQLite FTS5 plus optimized materialized/indexed semantic SQL, not only direct row retrieval.
Add dependency deletion/revocation with exact support-count delta or prove targeted recompute is acceptable.
Measure horizons 1..N and dynamic stop rules; fixed 2-hop closure is not a final cognition architecture.
Preserve Hyperposition conflicts/alternatives and measure false-binding rate, not only recall of positive possibilities.
Measure RSS/CPU/write amplification/rebuild/recovery on Hostinger Ubuntu and final Andreas Ubuntu target when an eligible execution lane exists.
